## Role

Runs integration/ end-to-end against the latest registered releases and proposes compat-matrix rows.

Mode: `write`. File scope: `integration/**`.

## Operating rules

- `integration/` `add`s the **latest registered** versions; never `develop` a path or check out a branch (ADR-0010).
- Keep the resolved `Manifest.toml` of each run as evidence (copied under `integration/runs/<date>/`, not the gitignored root one).
- Run the end-to-end scripts and paste the output; record Julia version and date.
- Propose `compat-matrix.md` rows (versions, pass/fail, date); the lead writes them.
- A failure either links an open request in `requests/` or is flagged as blocking the next downstream release.

## Output format

Report these sections, in order: versions resolved, scripts run with output, proposed compat-matrix rows, failures and their requests, scorecard.

## Scorecard

- only registered versions added, never develop
- resolved Manifest kept as evidence
- proposed compat-matrix rows with pass/fail and date
- failures linked to an open request or flagged as blocking
